item.text:
**1B.9 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador in 2024**

I found **partial evidence of precautionary institution-building** in cyber and biosafety, but also **clear evidence of weak transparency and oversight in cyber surveillance**. I did **not** find a clean 2024 AMLO executive AI-safety framework; the record is mostly biosafety, cyber hygiene, and oversight criticism.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable page URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Semarnat instala Comité Técnico Científico en materia de bioseguridad de organismos genéticamente modificados](https://www.gob.mx/semarnat/prensa/semarnat-instala-comite-tecnico-cientifico-en-materia-de-bioseguridad-de-organismos-geneticamente-modificados) | Secretaría de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales | 2024-02-01 | https://www.gob.mx/semarnat/prensa/semarnat-instala-comite-tecnico-cientifico-en-materia-de-bioseguridad-de-organismos-geneticamente-modificados | Semarnat created a technical-scientific biosafety committee to support risk evaluation, control, and management for GM-organism cases. The ministry explicitly framed this as correcting prior practice that had focused on authorizations without sufficient biosafety attention. | 1B.9, 1B.7 |
| [Prioriza agricultura acciones de sanidad e inocuidad en 2024](https://www.gob.mx/senasica/documentos/prioriza-agricultura-acciones-de-sanidad-e-inocuidad-en-2024) | Secretaría de Agricultura y Desarrollo Rural / Senasica | 2024-01-04 | https://www.gob.mx/senasica/documentos/prioriza-agricultura-acciones-de-sanidad-e-inocuidad-en-2024 | The government prioritized sanitary and food-safety actions, including inspection, phytosanitary/zoosanitary campaigns, surveillance systems, technical training, and certification of good practices. This is precautionary biological-risk management, even if it is not a frontier-catastrophic-risk policy. | 1B.9, 1B.7 |
| [GUÍAS DE CIBERSEGURIDAD](https://www.gob.mx/gncertmx/acciones-y-programas/guias-de-ciberseguridad) | Guardia Nacional CERT-MX | 2024-04-25 | https://www.gob.mx/gncertmx/acciones-y-programas/guias-de-ciberseguridad | The government published cyber-hygiene guidance for SMEs and families, aimed at improving resilience, safe handling of private data, and basic prevention against online threats. This supports precaution in the cyber domain. | 1B.9, 1B.7 |
| [Mexico: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House reported that the government used insecurity to justify expanding state surveillance with little accountability or oversight, and that a covert SEDENA cyberspace unit monitored critics and used inauthentic accounts. This is strong negative evidence on transparency and precaution in cyber governance. | 1B.9 |
| [Panel del T-MEC distribuye Informe Final en el caso México – medidas relacionadas con el maíz genéticamente modificado (MEX-USA-2023-31-01)](https://www.gob.mx/agricultura/prensa/panel-del-t-mec-distribuye-informe-final-en-el-caso-mexico-medidas-relacionadas-con-el-maiz-geneticamente-modificado-mex-usa-2023-31-01-386665) | Secretaría de Agricultura y Desarrollo Rural | 2024-12-20 | https://www.gob.mx/agricultura/prensa/panel-del-t-mec-distribuye-informe-final-en-el-caso-mexico-medidas-relacionadas-con-el-maiz-geneticamente-modificado-mex-usa-2023-31-01-386665 | The government said the TMEC panel concluded some elements of Mexico’s GM-corn/glyphosate decree could not stand because they were not based on adequate risk assessment, scientific evidence, or relevant international standards. Mexico disputed the panel, but this is credible counterevidence that its biological-risk policy was viewed as insufficiently evidence-based. | 1B.9, 1B.7 |

**Bottom line**

- Best-supported reading: **mixed, leaning positive on precautionary institution-building, but weak on transparency in cyber governance**.
- The clearest positives are biosafety committees, sanitary surveillance, and cyber-hygiene guidance.
- The clearest negatives are surveillance opacity and weak oversight in the cyber domain.
- I found **no clear 2024 AMLO-specific AI safety program** to evaluate directly.

**Search gap**

- The public 2024 record is thin on frontier AI governance and dual-use technology controls under AMLO specifically.
- Most of the usable evidence is indirect: biosafety, agricultural biosecurity, and cyber-resilience material, plus oversight criticism rather than a dedicated catastrophic-risk framework.
